subject: planner, executor: fix prepared string parameter compatibility in group/order by (#66387)
summary: Reviewed diff vs parent (2 files). Planner change gates treating prepared-stmt param markers as positional references in GROUP BY and GROUP_CONCAT(… ORDER BY …) to only when the bound param value type is int64/uint64; string params (even numeric strings like '0') are treated as value expressions. Executor seqtest adds regressions for issue #62556 covering both ORDER BY-in-GROUP_CONCAT and GROUP BY. No Blocker/High correctness/semantics/compatibility issues found in the touched planner/executor behavior.
